test_policy: First 128 seed-4701 source-hash-ordered official DeSSE test rows after length/markup and exact source/full-target exclusions; no grammar/content/reference-quality filtering

settings.baseline: Current two-beam T5 with tense/complement checks
settings.strict: Same baseline raw text plus independent-boundary/comma-splice checks
settings.search: Four deterministic beams; first passing beam or primary-beam word-preserving comma repair, otherwise original
settings.copy_policy: A valid highest-ranked copy stays a copy
settings.selection: No reference scores, no new thresholds, no test-driven changes
